questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?

All three pens have identical translucent grey barrels and black caps.

parsed.reason: The video shows a white board moving smoothly from left to right on a linear rail. It carries three identical pens, all capped and oriented in the same direction. There are no missing pens, wrong colors, or motion failures.
